title: लोग्नेमानिस र स्वास्नीमानिस निबन्धमा लैङ्गिक अध्ययन
nepali: प्रगतिवादी साहित्यकार श्यामप्रसाद शर्मा मूलतः निबन्धकार हुन् । उनका निबन्धमा शोषित, पीडित, उत्पीडित वर्गले खेप्नुपरेका विभिन्न समस्यालाई विषयवस्तुका रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरेको पाइन्छ । नेपाली समाजमा विद्यमान लैङ्गिक भेदभाव र शोषणलाई शर्माले विभिन्न उदाहरणकासाथ प्रस्तुत गरेका छन् । उनी लैङ्गिक शोषण र भेदभावको अन्त्य भई समानतामूलक उन्नत समाज निर्माण गर्नुपर्ने उद्धेश्यकासाथ निबन्ध रचना गर्ने निबन्धकार हुन् । शर्माका प्रकाशित निबन्धसङ्ग्रहमा अधिकांश शीर्षक नारीलाई केन्द्र बनाएर लेखिएका नारीवादी छन् । शर्माका विचारमा नर र नारी समाजरूपी रथका दुई पाङ्ग्रा हुन् । नेपाली समाजमा नारी रूपी रथको पाङ्ग्रा बिग्रेको जस्तो देखिन्छ । किनकी तत्कालीन नेपाली समाजका नारी आर्थिक, सामाजिक, राजनैतिक, धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक आदि सबै क्षेत्रमा धेरै नै पछाडि पेरका तथा पारिएका छन् । यस निबन्धमा नारीको अवस्था अत्यन्त कमजोर रहेको देखाउन निबन्धकार सफल भएका छन् । जबसम्म समाजरूपी रथका यी दुवै पाङ्ग्रा समान र बराबरीको हैसियतमा आउँदैनन् तबसम्म समाज तथा देश सम्पन्न बन्न सक्दैन् भन्ने मान्यता यस निबन्धमा प्रस्तुत भएको छ । लोग्नेमानिस र स्वास्नीमानिस निबन्धमा हाम्रो समाजका नारीहरूको अवस्था ज्यादै दयनीय भएको देखाउँदै नारीहरूलाई तिमीहरू प्राकृतिक रूपमा समान हौ; तिमीहरूलाई यहाँको समाजव्यवस्थाले र राज्यव्यवस्थाले जालझेल, षडयन्त्र गरेर पछि पारेको हो भन्ने पुष्टि गरिएको छ । नारीहरू चुप लागेर नबस आफ्नो अधिकार लिन अगाडि बढ् भन्ने कुरामा सचेत गराउने सन्दर्भ यस निबन्धमा प्रतिबिम्बन भएको देखिन्छ ।
american_english: Progressive writer Shyam Prasad Sharma is fundamentally an essayist. In his essays, various problems endured by the exploited, suffering, and oppressed classes are found to be presented as subject matter. Sharma has presented the gender discrimination and exploitation existing in Nepali society with various examples. He is an essayist who composes essays with the objective of ending gender exploitation and discrimination and building an egalitarian, advanced society. In Sharma's published essay collections, most titles are feminist, written with women at the center. In Sharma's view, man and woman are two wheels of the chariot of society. In Nepali society, the chariot wheel in the form of woman appears to be damaged. Because women in contemporary Nepali society have fallen and been pushed far behind in all fields including economic, social, political, religious, and cultural spheres. In this essay, the essayist has succeeded in showing that the condition of women is extremely weak. The belief presented in this essay is that until both of these wheels of the chariot of society arrive at an equal and equivalent status, society and the country cannot become prosperous. In the essay 'Lognemanis ra Swasnimanis,' while showing that the condition of women in our society is extremely pitiful, it is affirmed to women that you are naturally equal; you have been pushed behind through deceit and conspiracy by the societal system and state system here. The context of raising awareness among women not to stay silent but to move forward to claim their rights is seen to be reflected in this essay.

informal_english: Progressive author Shyam Prasad Sharma is basically an essayist first and foremost. In his essays, you see all the various struggles endured by exploited, suffering, and oppressed folks presented as the main subject matter. Sharma lays out the gender discrimination and exploitation existing in Nepali society with all kinds of examples. He is an essayist who writes his essays with the clear goal of ending gender exploitation and discrimination and building a truly equal, advanced society. In Sharma's published essay collections, most of the titles are feminist pieces written with women right at the center. As Sharma sees it, man and woman are the two wheels of the chariot of society. In Nepali society, the chariot wheel representing women seems to be busted. Because back in Nepali society at that time, women had fallen and been pushed way behind across every area—economic, social, political, religious, and cultural. In this essay, the essayist really manages to show that the condition of women is extremely vulnerable. The view put forward in this essay is that until both of these wheels of the chariot of society get on equal and even footing, neither society nor the country can ever become prosperous. In the essay 'Lognemanis ra Swasnimanis,' while showing that the condition of women in our society is truly heartbreaking, it tells women straight up: you are naturally equal; it is the social system and the state system here that pushed you behind through deceit and conspiracy. The message urging women not to just sit there quietly but to step forward and seize their rights is clearly reflected throughout this essay.
translator_notes: The essay title 'Lognemanis ra Swasnimanis' (Husband and Wife / Men and Women) kept transliterated with English quotation marks. Metaphors of the societal chariot (samajarupi ratha) and gender equality preserved in strict 12-sentence order across all variants. Informal flavour: American casual.
